sentences.text: The present petition under Article 226 of the Constitution is taking exception to the order dated 19.06.2023 passed by the trial court whereby the application for calling Investigating Officer of the case has been turn down.
2. Case under Section 166 and 140 of Motor Vehicle Act seeking compensation has been filed at the instance of claimant because of accident of earning member of the family.

During trial,
petitioner/claimant intends to call Investigating Officer to demonstrate the severity of injuries sustained by the victim.
3. In the present case, charge sheet has already been filed and therefore, it would not be apposite to call Investigating Officer for ascertaining the injuries sustained by the victim.
It is the domain of other expert, not the police personnel.
Court below has rightly passed the impugned order and rejected the application filed by the petitioner for calling the Investigating Officer.
4. Considering the submissions and the perusal of the impugned order, it appears that no illegality or impropriety has been caused by the Court below in passing the impugned order.
Therefore, no case for interference is made out under the limited jurisdiction of Article 227 of the Constitution.
5. Accordingly, petition sans merit and is hereby dismissed.
6 . However, the petitioner may take aid of charge-sheet and different documents including MLC are being filed alongwith Charge-sheet.

(ANAND PATHAK) JUDGE Rashid Harvendra Singh vs Ramnivas on 19 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/146112128/
